seo_article_outline.source_summary_for_editor:
Voyager 1 reached one light-day from Earth today. On the site you can: - see where both Voyagers are right now - open a nuclear battery to its 24 plutonium spheres - go into the data computer, down to a single memory chip - see how the Golden Record's cover explains how to play it - watch how Voyager 1 was fixed by radio - see which dish on Earth is listening to them, live I also made a 4-minute film from it:  https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kpzsRo-c1_A

 Points: 191 
 # Comments: 49
